18-more-question-practice.html 7/10.

15-ai-in-service-management.html 7/10. A newcomer with some AI background would follow most of the lesson, but would get stuck where the three kinds of AI are treated as separate boxes, and where Step 2 points to an outline they do not have.

15-ai-in-service-management.html 7/10. A newcomer would follow the steps but get stuck on a reference to a document they cannot open, a sorting-game category the lesson never introduces, and one unclear sentence about what counts as a good enough error rate.
